stresses: a 3-week gap: re-entry briefing; structure held; timers paused
description: The incident is resolved through the fleet fix (F35), the scientist registers a durability follow-up (the plan gesture on F35 compiles the load-test-and-verification item) and asks for tidying - provoking Class-2 compaction proposals that are pending at departure - then disappears for three weeks. On return, the retrospective batch (F29/F30/F32/F37/F31/F38/F40) lands. Re-entry must be a consequence-ranked briefing, the pending Class-2 proposals must have survived the gap unexpired (timers paused), the record must be structurally exactly as left, and the follow-up item must be taken up rather than re-derived.

events.text: the incident is basically closed - tidy the resolved causal sections down to summaries when you get a chance
events.expect: the agent proposes Class-2 face compactions of the resolved Q2 material; the proposals sit pending in the tray at departure, unratified

assertions.expect: re-entry after 21 days opens with a briefing: authored, past-tense, ranked by consequence (fix holding, clean peaks, the pending compaction decision, open durability questions), scaled to time away - not an activity diff or unread-item dump

the Class-2 compaction proposals provoked at t=32 are still pending and unexpired on return - their ~14-day expiry timers paused across the 21-day gap - and nothing above Class 1 was applied while away
the record's structure is exactly as left: the proposed compactions were not applied without ratification, and no promotion, demotion, split, or archive happened during the absence

the durability planned item registered at t=31 is taken up by this sitting and marked produced/absorbed as F38 (the load test) lands; the retrospective resumes from the plan rather than from re-derived context
the work record shows the 21-day gap honestly (no fabricated activity), and the post-gap sitting is findable from every section it touched
the Q3 detection post-mortem earns its section from the post-gap batch on its own evidence (F29/F30/F32/F37/F31/F40); nothing pretends the section existed during the gap
